libs.note: BH-9154 (Fix 3 of #9066): one lead review per ticket per real diff. bin/lib/lead-review/result.sh stores each done model lead verdict of a worklist head in the harness-jobs lead_ticket_verdicts table under (repo, ticket key, patch_review_fp of the head; bin/lib/patch-fp.sh). Gate 52 of the lead worklist asks it for a head of ANOTHER PR of the same ticket: a stored MERGE or MERGE-WITH-NOTES inside the window is posted on this head (bin/lead-verdict.sh post, note `lead-replay:<sha12> how:ticket-replay rebound: ticket-replay <pr>@<sha12>`) with no model call, and one review-saving event. A stored BLOCK, a miss, an unreadable read or a failed post is a full review. Both the writer and the gate read these knobs through lib_env_apply lead-ticket-replay.

knobs.note: The switch. 0 = gate 52 reads nothing and result.sh stores nothing; every head gets the review it got before BH-9154. Read as ${LEAD_TICKET_REPLAY:-1}.

How old a stored lead word may be and still be replayed onto another PR of the ticket. 86400 is the ticket's 24 h. The route refuses a window over 604800 (retention keeps rows 7 days, retention.lead_ticket_verdicts.days). A value outside min..max turns the replay off for that head, logged. Read as ${LEAD_TICKET_REPLAY_WINDOW_S:-86400}.
